Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the product overview earlier — the StratusAI procurement team asked me to pull together the billing and SKU questions before we progress to contract. Two quick asks: 1) how do you recommend mapping our product tiers to GCP Marketplace SKUs for both pay-as-you-go and committed billing, and 2) what handoff do you need from our procurement team so the purchase can hit a marketplace purchase (not a private invoice)?

Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -0700

Priya — thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary of what we need and next steps below. I've attached a first-pass SKU mapping (sku_mapping_v1.xlsx) and a draft MSA with our recommended redlines for marketplace deals.

Short answers:
- SKU mapping: we usually expose three SKUs for marketplace flows: basic (payg), pro (payg + committed), and enterprise (annual committed). The mapping matrix in the spreadsheet includes recommended unit definitions (vCPU-hours vs token units) and price bands.
- Procurement handoff: to ensure GCP Marketplace billing, we need: purchaser email with billing admin role, signed MSA (DocuSign link works), and the HubSpot deal ID so we can coordinate activations with our partner PM at Google.

Next steps: can you confirm Maria Lopez as the procurement contact and confirm whether StratusAI prefers committed or PAYG for initial launch? Once confirmed, Lauren will run the billing account handoff checklist with your procurement team.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: sku_mapping_v1.xlsx (xlsx), draft_msa_redlined.pdf (pdf)

> Priya — thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary of what we need and next steps below. I've attached a first-pass SKU mapping...

Thanks for starting this, Olga — a few operational notes from the partner side:
- GCP marketplace requires each SKU to be tied to a productOfferingId; we recommend keeping the number of SKUs minimal to reduce partner PM overhead. Your spreadsheet's 3-tier approach looks good.
- For committed SKUs, set a minimum contract quantity to simplify mapping to GCP billing quotas.
- Important: if StratusAI wants to co-sell through Google, sign-up for the co-sell program now; it speeds up listing approval. I'll share the partner guide URL (internal) below.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gcp-partner-guide

I'll be available next week to do the partner PM intro once we have the HubSpot deal ID.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
